topic: Trust-proof playbooks and printable checklists for security products: the artifact structure for proving trust claims, and integration with CI so the checklist stays true

subtopics.scope: Decomposing a product's trust claims into numbered, checkable verification axes (the 10-axis pattern: provenance, pinning, boot, storage, keys, enrollment, recovery, rollback, platform, failure).
seed_queries: software supply chain trust claims verification checklist
verify trust claims against running system not documentation

subtopics.scope: The 14-section operator playbook shape: purpose, scope, success criteria, then per-axis Goal/Checks/Pass-if/Fail-if blocks.
seed_queries: security operator runbook structure pass fail criteria
verification playbook success criteria sections goal checks

subtopics.scope: One-page printable checklist artifact design: name/date/host/arch header, one checkbox per line grouped in sections, final decision block with PASS/FAIL and signoff.
seed_queries: printable security checklist design one page signoff
checklist artifact design audit worksheet checkbox sections

subtopics.scope: Mapping each checkbox to a falsifiable rule (exit code, byte/string match, log count) so the trust decision is mechanically decidable, not subjective.
seed_queries: falsifiable verification rules security checklist exit code
mechanical verification commands audit checklist shell exit codes

subtopics.scope: Keeping the checklist true via CI: the CI gates as the automated counterpart, checkbox-to-test-to-signal cross-ref tables, and preventing drift between manual worksheet and CI.
seed_queries: CI pipeline parity manual security checklist gates
keep manual checklist in sync with CI tests drift

subtopics.scope: Structured adversarial test plans: baseline verification, intentional failures, recovery, upgrade and rollback phases with a final pass condition.
seed_queries: adversarial test plan phases failure injection recovery baseline
boot verification test plan upgrade rollback phases

subtopics.scope: The signed, dated, signed-off worksheet as audit evidence: packaging for HITRUST/CISA reviewers, filing copies with evidence bundles, PDF generation for printouts.
seed_queries: audit evidence packaging signed checklist compliance
compliance evidence artifact signoff auditor worksheet attestation

subtopics.scope: Verifying fail-closed behavior by breaking one thing at a time: wrong image, missing key, modified UKI, corrupted boot artifact, invalid enrollment state.
seed_queries: fail closed verification secure boot tamper detection
secure boot UKI tamper test fails closed verification
